    Plot predicted cell phase against true time

    plot_phase_scatter.Rd

    This function plots predicted cell phase against true cell time for simulation or example data with known ground-truth cell time. Cells are matched between res_phase and metadata by the cell column.

    plot_phase_scatter(
  res_phase,
  metadata,
  truth_by = "T_true",
  pred_by = "ZT_pred",
  point_color = "#A8C7E6",
  point_size = 0.45,
  point_alpha = 0.6,
  title = "Cell phase inference"
)

    Arguments

    res_phase

    A data.frame returned by infer_cell_phase().

    metadata

    A data.frame containing cell-level metadata.

    truth_by

    A character vector specifying the column name in metadata that contains true cell time in hours. Defaults to "T_true".

    pred_by

    A character vector specifying the column name in res_phase that contains predicted cell time in hours. Defaults to "ZT_pred".

    point_color

    A character vector specifying the point color. Defaults to "#A8C7E6".

    point_size

    A numeric value specifying the point size. Defaults to 0.45.

    point_alpha

    A numeric value specifying the point transparency. Defaults to 0.60.

    title

    A character vector specifying the plot title. Defaults to "Cell phase inference".

    Value

    Invisibly returns a list containing:

    plot

    A ggplot object.

    data

    The processed plotting data.

    metrics

    A data.frame containing cell number, mean absolute circular error, and median absolute circular error.

    Examples

    if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
data("srb_example_data")

res_phase <- infer_cell_phase(
  count = srb_example_data$Count,
  metadata = srb_example_data$meta,
  ZT_by = "ZT",
  strata_by = "celltype",
  Species = "mouse",
  setseed = 1,
  Verbose = FALSE
)

p_scatter <- plot_phase_scatter(
  res_phase = res_phase,
  metadata = srb_example_data$meta,
  truth_by = "T_true"
)

p_scatter$plot
p_scatter$metrics
} # }
